description.fun: Pansage and the other elemental monkeys were made for the Striaton City Gym, which doubles as a restaurant, so they share a cooking theme, down to hands shaped like oven mitts. The broccoli-like tuft on its head grows leaves that whisk away weariness, and kindly Pansage shares them, and the berries it gathers, with tired friends. With its mouth open, it plays 'speak no evil' of the three wise monkeys.
description.guide: Pansage is a Grass-type monkey Pokémon and one of the three elemental monkeys, with Pansear and Panpour. The leaves on its head relieve fatigue, and it shares them and the berries it gathers with others. It evolves into Simisage with a Leaf Stone.
description.tagline: A broccoli-haired monkey that shares its leaves with tired friends.

description.fun: Evolution turns kindly Pansage into an ill-tempered brawler: Simisage fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly, and the leaves on its head turn very bitter. Its pompadour may nod to Japan's rebellious yankee and bōsōzoku styles, which borrowed from 1950s rock-and-roll greasers, in contrast to Simipour's late-1960s hippie locks.
description.guide: Simisage is the evolved form of Pansage, a Grass-type monkey with a bushy crest of bitter leaves. It is ill-tempered and fights by striking with its thorn-covered tail.
description.tagline: A hot-tempered monkey with a pompadour and a thorny tail.
